item.text: IBAC reported to Parliament on its first five years of exposing and preventing public sector corruption and police misconduct.
item.support: report to Parliament on our actions to date, and reflect on future opportunities to strengthen Victoria’s corruption resistance

item.text: The report covers investigations, police oversight, prevention work and opportunities to strengthen its powers and independence.
item.support: Independent oversight of police to ensure they perform their duties and exercise their powers with integrity

item.text: IBAC reported completing 55 investigations and making 93 recommendations to police and public sector agencies.
item.support: Recommendations to police and public sector agencies 93

item.text: The Commissioner sought powers to follow public money through private providers, initiate proceeds-of-crime recovery and receive funding directly through Parliament.
item.support: IBAC be funded through appropriations directly from the Parliament

item.quote: After just five years, it is reasonable to conclude that IBAC has changed perceptions about corruption in Victoria.
